The Riding Archery Projection Simulation Archery Interactive Game Machine is an immersive interactive projection system designed for malls and indoor amusement parks. It combines horseback riding and archery elements, creating an engaging experience through advanced projection technology. Built with alloy materials, the machine is highly durable and supports a maximum weight of 100kg. It is suitable for groups of 5–10 people or fewer. The machine measures 600×200×300cm, weighs 250kg, and features a customizable screen ranging from 50 to 65 inches.


>> Features of Riding Archery Projection Simulation Archery Interactive Game Machine:


Uses 3D mapping projection to display virtual scenes in real space.

  • Projects immersive game environments onto physical surroundings.

  • Combines horseback riding and archery in a single gameplay experience.

  • Players shoot arrows while simulating a riding motion.

  • Enables real-time interaction through body movement or device control.

  • Promotes physical engagement with motion-based gameplay.



>> Advantages and Applications for the Riding Archery Projection Simulation Archery Interactive Game Machine by LJ Sports Technology:


Applications:


Designed for indoor entertainment venues.

Fits in malls, amusement parks, and similar locations.

Offers interactive experiences to attract visitors.

Advantages:


Delivers immersive gameplay through projected environments.

Compatible with various commercial settings.

Built with durable materials for long-term use.

Customization available to meet specific needs.

Includes lifetime software support for ongoing use.

>> FAQs for Riding Archery Projection Simulation Archery Interactive Game Machine:


Q1: What is the Riding Archery Projection Simulation Archery Interactive Game Machine?

A: It is an immersive game machine that combines horseback riding and archery using 3D projection technology. It allows users to interact with a virtual environment in real-time.


Q2: Where can this product be installed?

A: It is designed for indoor venues such as shopping malls, amusement parks, and entertainment centers.


Q3: How many people can use the machine at once?

A: It supports 5–10 users or smaller groups, depending on the configuration.


Q4: What materials are used to build the machine?

A: The machine is constructed from durable alloy materials to ensure long-term use.


Q5: What are the dimensions and weight of the machine?

A: The machine measures 600×200×300 cm and weighs 250 kg.
